result.reason: The redline reaches the customer-side fallback by retaining 90 days’ notice and capping the Termination Payment at three months of Section 3.1 payments. However, it leaves HDI with a mutual right to terminate on 90 days’ notice at any time, including during the committed term; the fallback permits vendor convenience termination only at the end of a term. The margin comment cannot cure that operative omission and also misidentifies the provision as Section 4.2(a). The changes are otherwise targeted and preserve unrelated commercial terms.
